title: fix(auth): a SCIM-deactivated sign-in says the organization deactivated the account, not that it was banned
body:
Fixes #32432

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：被身份提供方（SCIM）停用的员工用密码登录时，登录页现在显示「Your account has been deactivated by your organization. Contact your administrator.」（11 种语言），不再显示「You have been banned… contact support」；管理员封禁仍显示服务端原文。
- 为什么改：服务端（PR #32608）已在 `403 BANNED_USER` 上加了 `details.cause: 'scim_deactivated'`，但前端的认证客户端在抛错时把 `details` 丢了，登录表单也只按 `code` 查文案，所以被停用的员工看到的是「你被封禁了」。
- 风险与回滚：只改前端：认证客户端多带一个 `details` 字段、登录表单多一步按 `CODE:cause` 查文案、多一个翻译 key；无服务端、无元数据变更。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/auth/src/createAuthClient.ts`（`toAuthError` 带上 `details`，这是真正丢字段的地方）、`ui/packages/auth/src/LoginForm.tsx`（`refusalText` 的查找顺序）、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/auth/signInRefusalMessages.ts`（新加的 `BANNED_USER:scim_deactivated` 一行）。
- 两分钟验证：`cd ui && npx vitest run --root . packages/app-shell/src/console/auth/__tests__/loginRefusalCodes-11058.test.tsx -t "SCIM-deactivated"`，应看到 3 个用例全部通过（含管理员封禁的 CONTROL）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**Where the cause was lost (measured read path).** The server answers `{"code":"BANNED_USER","message":"You have been banned…","details":{"cause":"scim_deactivated"}}` (plugin-auth `banned-user-refusal-cause.ts`). The path to the form:

1. better-fetch (`@better-fetch/fetch` 1.3.2, used by better-auth 1.7.12) returns `error = { ...body, status, statusText }`, so `error.details` is present on the client side.
2. `createAuthClient.signIn` throws `toAuthError(error)`. **This is where `details` was dropped:** `toAuthError` copied `message`, `code`, `dependents` and `userMessage` only.
3. `AuthProvider.signIn` re-throws that same error object.
4. `LoginForm.handleSubmit` looked up `errorMessages[code]` only, then fell back to `message`.

So the producer half of the fix is in `createAuthClient.ts`, which is outside the claim's listed surface: the dispatch order named this case ("the auth client strips `details` before the form sees it") and said to fix it on the producer side.

- **`@object-ui/auth` `createAuthClient`:** `toAuthError` now carries the body's `details` onto the thrown error when it is a plain object. `message` and `code` are unchanged for every caller.
- **`@object-ui/auth` `LoginForm`:** a refusal is looked up under `CODE:cause` (`details.cause`) first, then `CODE`, then the server's message. It branches on `code` and `details.cause`, never on the message, as the server changeset instructs. A refusal with no cause, or with a cause the map has no entry for, answers exactly as before. The `errorMessages` prop type is unchanged (`Record<string, string>`); its doc names the `CODE:cause` spelling.
- **`@object-ui/app-shell` `signInRefusalMessages`** (the one map both login pages pass, the Console's `LoginPage` and `DefaultLoginPage`): adds `BANNED_USER:scim_deactivated`. No bare `BANNED_USER` entry is added, so an administrator's ban keeps the server's wording. Like the producer fix, this file is outside the claim's listed surface: the Console page imports the map from app-shell, so the refusal is mapped here and not under `ui/apps/console/src/pages/auth/**`. That tree is unchanged.
- **`@object-ui/i18n`:** adds `auth.login.errors.accountDeactivated` to all 11 packs. zh-Hant is regenerated from zh-Hans by `gen:zh-hant`, not hand-written. The sibling card's `optional` keys, which landed on `main` meanwhile, are kept: `main` was merged and nothing was dropped.

**Clause-②, measured:** `yes (widening)`. There is a new published `@object-ui/i18n` key, a new `details` field on `@object-ui/auth`'s thrown error, and a new lookup spelling in `errorMessages`. Nothing is removed or narrowed.

## Tests

Pins (all on `26459fd57`):

- `ui/packages/auth/src/__tests__/createAuthClient.test.ts`, describe "a sign-in refusal carries the body details". It drives the real better-auth client through a stubbed fetch. SCIM: `details` equals `{ cause: 'scim_deactivated' }`, and code and message are unchanged. CONTROL: an administrator's ban has no `details`. A `details` that is not a plain object (string, array, null) is not carried.
- `ui/packages/auth/src/__tests__/LoginForm.test.tsx`, describe "a refusal with a cause is mapped by CODE:cause". SCIM shows the deactivation sentence. An ordinary ban shows the ban wording. `CODE:cause` wins over a bare `CODE` entry. CONTROL: an unmapped cause answers like a refusal with no cause.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/auth/__tests__/loginRefusalCodes-11058.test.tsx`, describe "a SCIM-deactivated sign-in is not shown as a ban". This is the full chain under zh: the exported page, the real form, a real `AuthProvider` over a real `createAuthClient`, and a stubbed fetch. SCIM shows `zh-Hans` `accountDeactivated`. CONTROL: an administrator's ban shows the server's ban message.

Ablations. Each was run through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: the anchor hit 1→0, the blob changed, and on restore the blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

| mutation | red | stayed green |
|:--|:--|:--|
| delete the `details` carry in `toAuthError` | createAuthClient SCIM pin; app-shell full-chain SCIM pin | both CONTROLs; LoginForm pins (they mock the client) |
| delete the `CODE:cause` lookup in `refusalText` | LoginForm SCIM pin; `CODE:cause` wins over `CODE`; app-shell full-chain SCIM pin | CONTROLs; producer pins |
| rename the map key in `signInRefusalMessages` | app-shell full-chain SCIM pin | its CONTROL |

<details><summary>Test runs</summary>

- Touched files (`26459fd57`): `packages/auth/`, `packages/i18n/`, `packages/app-shell/src/console/auth/`: Test Files 161 passed (161), Tests 2440 passed, 13 skipped.
- `apps/console/src/pages/auth/` (`--project @object-ui/console`): Test Files 31 passed (31), Tests 300 passed.
- `type-check` for `@object-ui/auth`, `@object-ui/i18n` and `@object-ui/app-shell`: lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- **Declared narrowing:** the whole `@object-ui/app-shell` suite (more than 2,200 files) was not run locally. Only its `src/console/auth/` tests ran, and they are the only app-shell tests that read the changed map. CI's Test UI shards run the full package.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `DevAdminRow` on the Console login page (the local-development "Sign in as dev admin" chip) does its own `signInRefusalMessages(...)[code]` lookup, so it still keys on `code` alone. It only appears for a seeded dev admin on a development instance, so it is left unchanged.
- The phone-number sign-in doors answer better-auth's `BANNED_USER` with no cause: the server decorates `/sign-in/email` only, as #32608 states. A SCIM-deactivated user who signs in with phone and password therefore still sees the ban wording. This is a server-side scope inherited from #32608. It was not reproduced here.
- The `CODE:cause` key spelling is a convention of `errorMessages`; there is no typed nested map. The `Record<string, string>` prop and every existing caller stay unchanged, and both login pages pick up the entry from the one shared map.

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` (final head `26459fd57`): 39 derived commands, all exit 0. `--ran` reconciliation: 39 derived, 39 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. `check:type-check-debt` re-measured OK (0 entries above their record).
- i18n families on `26459fd57`: `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift` and `check:i18n-dead-keys` all exit 0, and `accountDeactivated` is not among the dead-key candidates.
- `check:changeset-fixed` and `check:nul-bytes` exit 0.
